epistemic_status: DESIGN ARTIFACT on the D023 amendment-3 immediate critical path. Specifies how competitor projections are archived so they are point-in-time provable. Design only where licensing is unresolved: the scraping/licensing stance for each source is a user call, surfaced explicitly and never assumed. The design draft was already in flight when this node was created; it lands under this node's directory.

reconciliation_source.note: Reconciled in place, not duplicated. The full design text lives in the draft; this file records the delta applied by M00 subordination and the resulting authoritative state.

m00_subordination_rulings_applied.target: draft Section 4, item 1 (Outcome labeling / CLV-style labels)
m00_subordination_rulings_applied.resulting_rule: No CLV-style quantity may be derived from the T2 final-state odds archive, without exception (C.2). Realized-outcome labels for scoring competitor-projection accuracy come from game results directly and require no archive at all.

Using the T2 final-state odds archive as a benchmark comparator for competitor projections is prohibited until the M00 contract is amended to add a use class (M00-U4 is descriptive/sanity-check only, never a feature or benchmark). Market-implied comparators in this design draw exclusively from the new T0 high-frequency capture pipeline, consistent with the draft's own pre-existing section 5.1 requirement.

m00_subordination_rulings_applied.caveat_text_verbatim: Coverage figures derive from a retrospective single-snapshot harvest (T2). They describe what the vendor could return in July 2026 about past games, not what was observable at any pregame instant. Presence in this census is not evidence a price was available, firm, or executable at any particular time.

final_state_archive_permitted_uses_in_th: M00-U1 (coverage / sanity checks) only, with the U1 caveat verbatim, per the mapping above.
final_state_archive_prohibited_uses_in_t: Any CLV-style or closing-line-value quantity derived from the T2 archive.

Using the T2 archive as a benchmark comparator (final projection vs final market number) for competitor-projection accuracy; this use is not currently enumerated by M00 and would require a contract amendment.
Any use of odds_snapshot_timestamp as witnessed.
Any timing, latency, lead-lag, reaction, or sequencing claim built from the T2 archive.

amendment_4_compliance.rule: Every future reaction-time claim carries explicit timestamp-uncertainty and vendor-latency terms; a claim that cannot carry both is reported UNSUPPORTABLE.
amendment_4_compliance.verification: All required fields are present as a strict subset of the draft's Section 3 schema (which additionally carries record_id, provider, player_id, provider_player_id, game_id, starter_status, projected_minutes, projection_fields, prev_value, change_magnitude, linked_information_event). No gap found.
amendment_4_compliance.comparison_rule_carried_forward: Benchmarks compare only rows sharing capture_rung AND ladder_run_id; rungs are never mixed or averaged across.
amendment_4_compliance.propagation_rule_carried_forward: Every benchmark output must propagate contributing provider_update_ts_confidence values, non-empty capture_latency_notes, and license_basis values; dropping them makes the result non-compliant and unpresentable as a claim.

capture_ladder_summary.cutoff_discipline: Fixed-cutoff: value visible at the cutoff is archived; later revisions arrive as new records via new capture_ts / record_id, never as edits to an existing row.
capture_ladder_summary.comparison_discipline: Two projections are 'simultaneous' only if they share capture_rung AND target game AND ladder_run_id.

storage_retention_identity_conventions_r.append_only: Reuses the existing capture layer's append-only convention (props_capture_daily.py / injury_capture_daily.py pattern documented in CAPTURE_UPGRADE_DESIGN.md): corrections/revisions are new rows, never UPDATEs.
storage_retention_identity_conventions_r.player_id_index: Reuses the existing canonical player_id resolution convention (established via migrate_o14_capture_player_id.py) rather than matching provider name-strings directly; provider_player_id retained alongside for audit/re-resolution.
